# Inline Emphasis In Cells

## Emphasis Variants

| Variant | Example | Long Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| emphasis | *italic text* | *italic phrase with enough words to wrap inside a table cell* |
| strong | **bold text** | **bold phrase with enough words to wrap inside a table cell** |
| strong emphasis | ***bold italic text*** | ***bold italic phrase with enough words to wrap inside a table cell*** |

## Underscore Variants

| Variant | Example | Long Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| emphasis | _italic text_ | _italic phrase with enough words to wrap inside a table cell_ |
| strong | __bold text__ | __bold phrase with enough words to wrap inside a table cell__ |
| strong emphasis | ___bold italic text___ | ___bold italic phrase with enough words to wrap inside a table cell___ |

## Mixed Inline Emphasis

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| mixed short | plain *italic* **bold** ***both*** |
| mixed long | plain text before *italic phrase* then **bold phrase** then ***combined phrase*** with enough words to wrap |
| punctuation | (*italic*) [**bold label**](https://example.com) |
